cleaning.name: Empty dish rack and wipe counters (while coffee brews)
Squeegee shower and wipe sink (after shower)
10-min reset: dishes, cushions, quick vacuum (at log-off)
Wipe stove if you cooked, run dishwasher (before bed)
Bathroom (toilet, shower, mirror, floor) + change sheets and wash towels
Kitchen: microwave, appliance fronts, fridge purge
Monthly deep clean (~45 min): baseboards, vents, light fixtures, inside fridge, wash shower liner and bath mats, vacuum under furniture, washer clean cycle

intention.text: Give one thing your full attention before picking up the next.
